apps.name: AthleteOS Recorder
apps.localizedDescription: Raw Polar H10 overnight recorder. AthleteOS performs all analysis and coaching.

versions.localizedDescription: Fixes Polar SDK error 2/3 during morning save by using the connected CoreBluetooth peripheral UUID for stored-file reads and explicitly recovering a lost SDK/GATT session before retrying. The H10 sensor copy remains untouched until AthleteOS verifies upload.
